title: One view of governed execution per replay, counted
note: GovernedOrigins.shared and its callers: the store's load, catch-up (both paths) and snapshot restore, a single origin question, reuse and the invalidation cascade; and the independent reader's one task replay per reconstruction. The suite counts origin questions against views built on a genuine history of five admissions, with the probe shown to see one view per question when sharing is switched off.

mutations.name: RV1_the_load_shares_nothing
mutations.rationale: a load builds one view per admission again: O(n*k)

mutations.name: RV2_the_restore_shares_nothing
mutations.find:
with self._one_origin_view():
            for rid, rec in list(rebuilt.items()):
mutations.replace:
with nullcontext():
            for rid, rec in list(rebuilt.items()):
mutations.rationale: a snapshot restore re-decides each admission from its own view

mutations.name: RV3_the_full_catch_up_shares_nothing
mutations.rationale: a catch-up without an anchor builds one view per admission it folds

mutations.name: RV4_the_anchored_catch_up_shares_nothing
mutations.find:
with self._one_origin_view():
                    for ev in events:
mutations.replace:
with nullcontext():
                    for ev in events:
mutations.rationale: the live path, folding from its anchor, builds one view per admission it folds

mutations.name: RV5_a_question_builds_two_views
mutations.rationale: the report's producers and the bundle's are each read from a view of their own

mutations.name: RV6_a_shared_view_is_rebuilt
mutations.rationale: the view is held and never used

mutations.name: RV7_a_nested_scope_discards_the_outer_view
mutations.find:
if self._shared is not None:
            yield self
            return
        self._shared = []
mutations.rationale: each question's own scope resets the load's, so the load shares nothing

mutations.name: RV8_reuse_shares_nothing
mutations.rationale: a reuse search builds one view per candidate

mutations.name: RV9_the_cascade_shares_nothing
mutations.rationale: an invalidation builds one view per result it asks after

mutations.name: RV10_the_reader_replays_tasks_per_admission
mutations.rationale: the independent reader replays every task once per admission it decides

mutations.name: RV11_the_counter_counts_nothing
mutations.rationale: the guard's own unit disabled: every count reads zero and proves nothing
